name: jadarah-cv-skills-v1
description: Synthetic, fictional CV excerpts (no real people) hand-labelled with the taxonomy skills a reviewer would accept as claimed by the candidate. Includes negations, ambiguous words and aliases on purpose.

cases.text: Data analyst with 4 years of experience. Built Power BI dashboards and wrote SQL queries against PostgreSQL. Automated reporting with Python and pandas.
Frontend engineer: React, Next.js and TypeScript. Wrote automated tests with Playwright and set up CI/CD in GitHub Actions. Familiar with Figma handoff.
Backend developer (Java, Spring Boot). Designed REST API design guidelines and deployed services with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS.
I have no experience with Python yet but I am eager to learn. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills from retail operations.
Project coordinator. Maintained Primavera schedules and tracked the critical path for a 40 km road project; prepared BOQ and cost estimates.
Ready to go wherever the team needs me. I react quickly to customer issues and improved customer experience scores by 12%.
Security analyst: SIEM operations (Splunk), incident response playbooks and threat analysis. Reviewed web apps against the OWASP Top 10.
Machine learning engineer. Trained deep learning models in PyTorch, classical models with scikit-learn, and maintained MLOps pipelines.
Finance graduate. Financial modeling in Advanced Excel, budgeting and forecasting for a family business, basic IFRS accounting coursework.
Events lead for a 30,000-visitor festival: event planning, vendor management and crowd management with the civil defence team.
Data engineer: ETL pipelines on Apache Spark orchestrated with Airflow; data modeling for the warehouse. Not familiar with Tableau.
Quality engineer: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, root cause analysis, statistical process control and ISO 9001 internal audits.
Product manager. Owned the roadmap and product strategy, ran user research interviews and wrote requirements with engineering.
Platform engineer: Terraform for Azure infrastructure, Linux administration, Git workflows. Some exposure to Go services.
Policy researcher. Policy analysis on consumer protection regulation and regulatory compliance reviews for a government entity.
Graduate in computer science. Courses: data structures and algorithms, statistics, natural language processing. Final project in C# and SQL Server.
Credit analyst at a bank: credit analysis, financial analysis of SME borrowers and risk assessment memos.
UI designer creating prototypes in Figma; accessibility reviews (WCAG) and design systems. I do not code in JavaScript.
Maintenance planner in a petrochemical plant: maintenance planning, process safety (HAZOP) and BPMN process modeling of work orders.
Built LLM applications with retrieval for internal search using Node.js and JavaScript; identity and access management with Azure AD.
